text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。
text_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which mentions actively developing a unified national coal trading market, improving foundational systems and rules, strengthening information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the national coal trading center. It also calls for improving the medium- and long-term contract system for coal power supply assurance, promoting standardized and normalized coal trading contracts, and strengthening supervision of contract signing and performance. The plan aims to improve the coal market price formation mechanism, timely refine coal price range regulation policies based on market conditions and cost changes, and regulate price index behavior.
